scope: provider-free @gotgenes/pi-permission-system@40.3.0 policy and tool_call gate checks

attempts.finding: The SDK public root did not export loadExtensions; an initial fake API approach could not provide registered tools or prove package-hook mediation.
attempts.resolution: Replaced it with SdkPiSessionAdapter and the public AgentSession.extensionRunner.emitToolCall() seam.

attempts.finding: Policy checks all resolved to the default ask state because the isolated agent-directory variables were not set before loading the candidate entry.
attempts.resolution: Set HOME, PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR, and XDG directories to the fresh temporary scope before extension initialization.

attempts.finding: The fixture tool inherited the configured deny fallback because no explicit fixture_tool allow rule existed.
attempts.resolution: Added the exact synthetic fixture_tool allow rule, retained the global deny fallback, then reran the full probe.

attempts.finding: Policy and hook outcomes were correct, but the probe reached the SDK session through the private SdkPiSessionAdapter handle.session property.
attempts.resolution: Retained the sanitized diagnostic and replaced access with the public extensionSdk.createRuntime seam and AgentSessionRuntime.session getter.

attempts.summary: Seven policy checks matched. Actual registered hook passed the allowed fixture tool and blocked denied write, headless ask, and unregistered tool; the in-memory counter advanced once. SDK dispose resolved, fixture shutdown was observed, worker exit and empty process group were confirmed, and both temporary scopes were removed.

Rerun after adding supervisor SIGKILL escalation, bounded output capture and fresh archive-path preflight. Seven policy queries and four hook outcomes passed, with observed process and temporary-scope cleanup.
Final rerun records timeout_triggered explicitly and forbids PASS when the deadline fires. All policy/hook outcomes and cleanup checks passed; timeout was not triggered.
